photos.file_title: File:HDLG-2416 7 x 5 Dot Matrix Green LED Display.jpg
photos.author: Mister rf
photos.description: The HDLG-2416 is a 4-character 5mm smart 5 x 7 Alphanumeric Display driven by an on-board CMOS IC. The IC stores and decodes 7 bit ASCII data and displays it using a 5 x 7 font. Multiplexing circuitry and drivers are also part of the IC.
